Let me profile a single request with 24 services, L=4, k=10.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json, random, cProfile, pstats, io
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as impl
rng = random.Random(5)
svc = ['t%d'%i for i in range(24)]
specs = [tuple(rng.choice(svc) for _ in range(4)) for _ in range(10)]
when = {'op':'and','args':[{'op':'contains','path':list(p)} for p in specs]}
req = {'services':svc,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':when}],'queries':[[svc[0],svc[1]]]}
payload = json.dumps(req).encode()
pr = cProfile.Profile(); pr.enable()
impl.process(payload)
pr.disable()
s = io.StringIO(); pstats.Stats(pr, stream=s).sort_stats('tottime').print_stats(14)
print(s.getvalue())
EOF
